content: I will update the `getWorkflowProgress` function in `index.html` to remove the server metrics auto-detection, which was incorrectly skipping the user to the final step on their first click due to pre-loaded system stats. This change ensures that the step-by-step progress starts clean from Step 1.

args.Description: "Fixed progress auto-detect bug in getWorkflowProgress to ensure step-by-step wizard starts from Step 1 on first click."
args.Instruction: "Change getWorkflowProgress to initialize progress to 0 without metrics auto-detection."
